record_title: Heightwise stationary balance and sharp recurrence barriers in the Rabinovich–Fabrikant flow
provenance: Analytic invariant-measure, Lie-derivative, cutoff, and equality-rigidity arguments for the Rabinovich–Fabrikant flow.
limitations: Requires alpha,gamma>0 and compact support for the invariant-measure statements. The results are necessary stationary and recurrence constraints, not attractor-existence or chaos criteria. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; older Russian-language and model-specific literature creates residual priority risk.
